environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on EKS v1.28 in namespace 'data-pipeline'. Calico CNI with GlobalNetworkPolicy 'deny-cloud-metadata' applied at priority 100. The policy spec uses a combination of namespace selector (projectcalico.org/name == 'data-pipeline') with destination CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on port 80 TCP set to Deny action. Additionally, a second Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy 'deny-gcp-metadata' targets metadata.google.internal resolution via DNS policy integration (Calico DNS policy with domain sets). The pod's projected service account token audience is restricted to 'sts.amazonaws.com' only. Note: the Calico policies use 'order: 100' which means they evaluate AFTER any order < 100 policies, and there exists a namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy 'allow-internal-egress' with order 500 that permits egress to 10.0.0.0/8 — this does NOT override the GlobalNetworkPolicy deny since Calico evaluates global policies first regardless of order field when using GlobalNetworkPolicy vs namespaced NetworkPolicy resources.
